faqs.q: Can I join if I'm from a non-HR background?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our program is designed for ALL graduates - BCom, BA, BSc, B.Tech, BBA, MBA - regardless of your previous field. We start from fundamentals and build you up to job-ready level.

faqs.q: What is the total course fee?
faqs.a: Course fees are competitive and vary by batch and mode (online/offline). We also offer EMI options and early bird discounts. Contact our admissions team for the current fee structure.

faqs.q: Is this program available online or offline?
faqs.a: We offer both classroom training (Hyderabad) and live online classes. Online students also get access to recorded sessions, live doubt-clearing calls, and the same placement support as classroom students.

faqs.q: What kind of placement support is provided?
faqs.a: Our dedicated placement team provides resume building, LinkedIn optimization, mock interviews, company referrals, interview scheduling, and ongoing follow-up until you are placed. We work with 50+ active hiring partners.

faqs.q: What certificate will I receive upon completion?
faqs.a: You will receive an industry-recognized certificate from SV Professionals, acknowledged by our placement partners. It validates your expertise in core HR functions including payroll, recruitment, compliance, and HR operations.

faqs.q: How is this program different from other HR courses?
faqs.a: Unlike theory-heavy programs, every module at SV Professionals includes live projects, real-time case studies, and role plays. Our trainers are working HR professionals, not just academics. Our 2-3 month intensive format is built to make you job-ready fast.

faqs.q: Is Advanced Excel knowledge required before joining?
faqs.a: No prior Excel knowledge is required. Our Advanced Excel for HR module starts from scratch and takes you through all the functions an HR professional needs - payroll sheets, MIS reports, attrition trackers, and dashboards.
We offer morning and evening weekday batches to accommodate working professionals, college students, and job seekers. Batch timings are confirmed at the time of enrollment based on your preference.
